verified: Strict configuration requires exact primary/fallback/embedding descriptors, disclosure and secret references.
Router selects the product-selected primary first and only retries a retryable provider failure with a compatible fixed fallback.
Authorization, invalid input and disclosure expansion never bypass the fallback policy.
Trusted provider receives raw credentials only inside the adapter; traces contain identity, purpose, refs, usage, cost and latency but no secret value.
Opaque provider-secret sources are separate from fixed-size encryption-key sources and return credentials only across the trusted adapter boundary.

OpenRouter transport posts only the protected input reference's validated text, consumes SSE output, records provider/model/generation metadata and actual token/cost usage, and redacts machine-secret-shaped output before protected persistence.
OpenRouter retryable HTTP/network failures and non-retryable authentication, payment, input, tool-call and output-persistence failures map to stable terminal events without response-body logging.
Model Router preserves provider observation in the terminal protected Trace payload.
Pi/product boundary remains product-owned; no Pi model selection, Session persistence, Skills discovery or built-in tools were added.
Strict configuration accepts provider-specific routing fields and rejects unknown, duplicate or invalid routing values.

Strict configuration requires generation runtime metadata and an independent embedding descriptor with explicit capabilities, four-field cost boundary and dimensions matching the Mem0 vector dimension; fallback descriptors are private-only.
resolveConfiguredModelDescriptorSet maps only explicit OpenRouter primary/fallback descriptors into Pi and keeps embedding identity outside the Pi generation binding.

ConfiguredPiModelBindingPort registers exactly the selected primary and fallback models, disables Pi disk model discovery/network refresh, resolves the production-suitable provider secret lazily, and keeps the raw value out of descriptors, runtime options and diagnostics.

Production model composition matches ModelDescriptor and Pi descriptor identity/capabilities, shares the approved host provider-secret source, and connects the protected OpenRouter transport with the closed Pi binding.

Agent Service validates the embedding descriptor at startup, creates the supported production Model/Pi composition from strict configuration, reports descriptor-only diagnostics for deterministic profiles, and closes the composition before the durable repository.
Repeated streamed output sequences and repeated terminal provider events produce one output reference and one terminal Trace result.
